about.heading: About Us & Our History
about.stageCaption: Radhamadhob Sanatan Cultural Alliance · Stage Performance
about.defaultParagraph1: Our primary objective is to propagate and expand Sanatan Dharma through Vedic and Sattvic entertainment, and to create awareness to stop impure entertainment at Puja mandaps and sacred pilgrimage sites.
about.defaultParagraph2: We dramatize the history and mythological events of Sanatan Dharma to spread awareness and devotion among everyone through sacred entertainment. We invite you to always stand by our side to carry this mission forward.
about.defaultVision: Let entertainment be Sattvic, let culture be Sanatan — Awaken history, awaken consciousness. Dramatizing the history and mythological chronicles of Sanatan Dharma for all.
about.defaultMission: To propagate and expand Sanatan Dharma through Vedic and Sattvic entertainment and build awareness against impure entertainment at Puja mandaps and sacred pilgrimage sites.
